notes.title: We are now accepting applications for the playtest of "Blaze of Storm".
notes.content: [p]We are now accepting applications for the playtest of "Blaze of Storm". [/p][p]As this is a game under development, there are a few points to note. Please do not disclose the information obtained in the test play. The test version will be disabled after the test period ends. Please leave your feedback on Discord (there is a link on the Steam page). You can play as much as you can. Thank you for your cooperation.[/p][p][/p][p]2025/7/12[/p][p]Applications are now closed. Thank you for your cooperation.[/p]

notes.title: The DEMO version is available now!
notes.content:
Includes Caravan mode only. Give it a try!
We welcome your feedback.
Feel free to stream the video and post on social media.
The full version is scheduled for release at the end of 2025.

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility
notes.content:
This game is fully functional on steam Deck, and works great with the built-in controls and display.

[list]
[*] All functionality is accessible when using the default controller configration
[*] In-game interface text is legible on Steam Deck
[*] This game's default graphics configuration performs well on Steam Deck
[/list]

notes.title: TERARIN GAMES' latest title “Blaze of Storm” Steam page is now open!
notes.content:
Blaze of Storm is a vertical scrolling shmup in which you use explosions from a variety of sub weapons to destroy enemies in cyberspace.
Please add it to your wish list.
